clearer_why: In A every edge has its own clean orthogonal route with a label chip sitting on it, so verify/browse/checkout and placed/settled/card are unambiguous, and the text is larger. In B, settled and card share one stem out of Payments, the Event bus fan-out lines bunch together, the 'email' arrow cuts through the Event consumers heading, and labels like verify/browse float away from their lines.
looks_why: B has a cohesive muted palette, tidy typography, small-caps group labels and orange emphasis on the main path, and it fits in one compact image. A's thick black strokes, grey highlighter-style label chips and unrelated pink/teal/orange group fills look dated, and it is stretched over two screens with long empty vertical runs; B loses some of this to its crowded routing.
weak_A: tall, stretched layout with heavy strokes, crude grey label chips and clashing pastel group fills
weak_B: crowded, overlapping edges and small text, with floating labels that make some arrows ambiguous

B has a nicer palette and card styling, but its overlapping lines and cramped lower half look messy next to A; A's weakness is the amount of vertical scrolling and the blank space.
